response.sql: WITH per_rating AS (SELECT f.rating, COUNT(*) AS rentals FROM rental r JOIN inventory i ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id JOIN film f ON f.film_id = i.film_id GROUP BY f.rating), overall AS (SELECT AVG(rentals) AS avg_rentals FROM per_rating) SELECT AVG(p.rentals) AS avg_rentals_above, AVG(p.rentals - o.avg_rentals) AS avg_gap_above FROM per_rating p CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE p.rentals > o.avg_rentals;
